purpose: Curated semantic neighborhoods for the worksheet New Question control. These groups authorize close alternate question families without allowing random drift across a worksheet.

groups.label: Factor Quadratic Expressions
groups.intent: Factor a quadratic or special quadratic polynomial completely. The student action remains factoring an expression, not solving an equation or expanding a product.

requirements: Use a visibly different legal factor structure from Candidate 1.
If Candidate 1 has leading coefficient a = 1, prefer a factorable a != 1 trinomial.
If Candidate 1 has a != 1, prefer a monic or GCF-then-factor quadratic when appropriate.
Use integer factors/roots and require complete factoring.
Use a quadratic special case: difference of squares or perfect-square trinomial.
Choose a different special pattern from any already visible candidate when possible.
Use a different special pattern from Candidate 1 when possible: difference of squares versus perfect-square trinomial.
Use a standard factorable quadratic trinomial.
Prefer leading coefficient a != 1 when it provides useful variety.
Use integer factors/roots and require complete factoring.
